en.description:
BlockWatch Puzzle is a clean, satisfying block puzzle designed from the ground up for Apple Watch.

Drop colorful blocks onto a 6×6 grid and fill complete rows or columns to clear them. The longer you last, the higher your score — can you beat your best?

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Motion — tilt your wrist to move a piece up and down, and use Double Tap to slide it sideways. Rest it on an empty spot and it drops on its own. Play completely hands-free.
• Touch — prefer the classic way? Drag each piece with your finger and release to place it.

FEATURES
• Made only for Apple Watch — no iPhone needed
• Simple to learn, hard to put down
• Satisfying clear effects, sound and haptics
• Light and Dark themes
• Adjustable sound and music
• Local high score to chase every day

No accounts. No ads. No internet required. Just raise your wrist and play.

Clear the board. Beat your best.
en.releaseNotes:
Rebuilt from the ground up.

• All-new block design with crisp 3D bevels
• Fresh color palette — vivid, never harsh
• Real shatter effect: blocks burst into pieces and fall off screen
• New sound effects for every move, clear and combo
• Combos now survive 3 moves, so a chain is easier to keep alive
• Redesigned menu and app icon
• Much smoother — the whole renderer was rewritten

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
Version 1.1

• All-new touch controls — drag a block from the tray onto the board.
• Next-piece preview to plan ahead.
• Bigger board, brighter colors, and a fresh look.
• Smoother dragging with a landing preview.
• Performance improvements and bug fixes.

Thanks for playing!

Version 2.0 — the biggest update yet!
• New 3-piece tray: pick any of three blocks and drop it where you want.
• Smart pieces that always leave you a way to keep playing.
• Pieces now arrive in different rotations for more variety.
• Redesigned 3D beveled blocks and a fresh, vibrant color palette.
• Satisfying line-clear light effects, combo praise, and a color celebration.
• New music tracks and combo sounds that build as you go.
• New app icon, plus performance and size improvements.

• Stunning new glass blocks — glossy, jewel-like, and satisfying to place
• Vibrant colors that change every round — no two boards look the same
• A fresh new app icon
• Punchier line-clear and combo effects
• Smaller, smoother, and more optimized

Beat your best. You'll be hooked.
